mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and 73 degrees at Fireman's Park. Look for the moon in its waxing crescent phase tonight, and keep an eye on the northwest sky near Verona High School at 8:25 PM to spot the space station gliding toward the northeast near Home Depot for five minutes.
The city is encouraging all residents to subscribe to the digital newsletter on the city website to stay informed about upcoming projects and local programs.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market, Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus tomorrow.
On September 5, officers responded to a peculiar incident where several vehicles were found with cheese placed on their windshields, identified as a viral social media prank known as the Dairy Dare.
Culver's is open today until 10:00 PM; however, please note that the store is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day to report at this time.
